text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: The cumulative area of inflow minus outflow equals the change in stored volume
Same linear-reservoir solution as866. Positive cumulative I−O fills storage; later negative differences drain it. Maximum storage occurs when I=O on the
falling inflow limb, not necessarily at inflow peak. Shading is a discharge-time area, which becomes volume only after consistent time units; small
positive tail storage remains at10 h.
